category: Implement and Maintain Secure Environments for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Implement and maintain secure environments for developing software, including the build infrastructure, source-control systems, and testing environments, with appropriate access controls and segregation.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-15, CM-5, CM-7, SC-7
implementation_examples: Isolate build runners from production networks
Enforce MFA and least-privilege on source-control systems
assessment_objectives: Determine whether development environments implement access controls and segregation.
Determine whether environments are immutable or controlled for drift.
